command.only_environment_change: LD_LIBRARY_PATH prepends the installed Vitis Ubuntu/24, Ubuntu and base library directories; compiler options, source and outputs match the released first frontend attempt.

compiler_dependency_closure.method: Parse compiler-emitted Make dependency file, unfold backslash-newline, shlex-split prerequisites; hash exact referenced bytes. Closure digest is SHA256 over sorted tab-separated path, byte count, SHA256 rows with LF endings.

top_ir.interpretation: Frontend IR records all 26 aggregate field initializations directly in the top; this is a structural source precheck, not CSim, synthesis, timing or hardware proof.
